# ML-Biomat

> Bilingual research tutorials, scientific computing and biomaterials resources.

Public reading requires no account or credentials. Follow the license and attribution notices in each resource.

## Reading and search

- [Page and Markdown index](https://ml-biomat.com/agent-index.json)
- [Search index](https://ml-biomat.com/search.json)
- [Complete text](https://ml-biomat.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Public access](https://ml-biomat.com/auth.md)

Each page below has a Markdown sibling named `index.md`. HTML remains the browser representation.

## Articles and tutorials

- [zh] [AFM力曲线分析：信号标定与弹性模量拟合](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/afm-force-curve-python-zh/index.md) — 从 AFM 偏转信号转换为力，完成基线校正与接触点识别，再对压入数据进行拟合。标定几何、解析 Hertz 曲线与 Python 函数共同说明测量通道如何转换为黏附力和具有明确单位的弹性模量。
- [en] [Practical AFM Force Curve Analysis with Python](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/afm-force-curve-python/index.md) — Convert AFM deflection into force, correct the baseline and identify contact before fitting indentation data. Calibration geometry, analytic Hertz curves and Python functions connect measured channels to adhesion and elastic modulus with explicit units.
- [zh] [生物材料的层级超结构：从分子到宏观的力学设计](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/bio-hierarchical-structures-zh/index.md) — 梳理丝素、胶原、骨、珍珠层与纤维素在不同尺度上的结构组织。通过胶原排列与片晶界面示意解释载荷传递和裂纹偏转，并连接显微表征、力学测试与多尺度建模方法。
- [en] [Hierarchical Superstructures in Biomaterials](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/bio-hierarchical-structures/index.md) — Explore how silk, collagen, bone, nacre and cellulose organize structural units across scales. Collagen packing and platelet-interface diagrams explain load transfer and crack deflection, with links to characterization and modeling methods.
- [zh] [生物材料力学测试：试样制备、应变测量与误差](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/biomaterials-mechanical-testing-zh/index.md) — 从试样几何、水合状态、装夹与应变测量出发，建立可重复的生物材料力学测试流程。结合力到应力的换算、直径误差传播和报告要点，明确模量、强度与耗能所对应的测试条件。
- [en] [Mechanical Testing of Biomaterials: A Reproducible Protocol Guide](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/biomaterials-mechanical-testing/index.md) — Plan specimen geometry, hydration, gripping and strain measurement for reproducible biomaterial tests. Follow force-to-stress conversion, diameter-error propagation and reporting choices to obtain mechanical properties with clearly defined test conditions.
- [zh] [生物分子网络的粗粒化建模：从映射方案到验证方法](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/coarse-grained-biomolecular-networks-zh/index.md) — 围绕生物分子网络选择珠子映射、有效相互作用与平衡策略，并规划独立验证。通过原子分组、参考分布与有效势的示意，说明粗粒化模型需要保留哪些结构信息和力学观测量。
- [en] [Coarse-Grained Modeling of Biomolecular Networks: A Practical Guide](https://ml-biomat.com/posts/coarse-grained-biomolecular-networks/index.md) — Choose bead mappings and effective interactions for biomolecular networks, then plan equilibration and independent validation. Worked diagrams connect atomic groups, reference distributions and the mechanical quantities a coarse-grained model should preserve.

- [en] [Long Chains, Soft Matter and Time: A Starting Point](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp00/en/index.md) — Why does rubber recover, plastic creep, and a water-rich gel hold its shape? Begin with atoms, molecules and long chains, distinguish connectivity from conformation, then connect condensed states, thermal motion and mechanical response through an interactive relaxation experiment.
- [zh] [长链怎样变成材料：高分子统计物理的入口](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp01/index.md) — 橡皮筋能回弹，塑料熔体会缓慢流动，蛋白质能改变形状并完成特定功能。这些现象都涉及长链分子的许多可能状态。先从链的连接和可数的构象出发，理解概率、熵、热运动与观察时间怎样把微观结构连接到材料的力学、混合和生命功能。
- [en] [How Long Chains Become Materials: An Introduction to Polymer Statistical Physics](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp01/en/index.md) — Rubber recovers, polymer melts flow slowly, and proteins change shape to perform specific functions. These behaviors involve many possible states of long-chain molecules. Begin with connectivity and countable conformations, then connect probability, entropy, thermal motion and observation time to mechanics, mixing and biological function.
- [zh] [从一个状态到许多可能：相空间、概率与系综](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp02/index.md) — 知道一条链或一个粒子在哪里，还不足以预测它接下来怎样运动；只看一次测量，也不一定得到稳定的材料性质。从位置与动量出发，建立状态空间和概率平均，再用能量、热浴和粒子交换说明不同系综。最后比较慢跳转过程中的时间平均与系综概率，理解平衡与观测时间之间的关系。
- [en] [From One State to Many Possibilities: Phase Space, Probability and Ensembles](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp02/en/index.md) — Knowing where a chain or particle is does not fully determine its next motion, and one observation need not give a stable material property. Begin with position and momentum, build state space and probability averages, and distinguish ensembles through energy, thermal contact and particle exchange. A slow-jump model then connects equilibrium probabilities with finite observation times.
- [zh] [一条链能占多大空间：理想链的构象统计](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp03/index.md) — 沿链量出的长度、两端之间的距离和整条链的空间尺寸，为什么是不同的量？从随机步子出发，逐步理解回转半径、库恩长度、概率分布和熵弹性，再比较柔性链、半刚性链与环状和支化结构。
- [en] [How Much Space Does a Chain Occupy? Ideal-Chain Statistics](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp03/en/index.md) — Contour length, end-to-end distance and overall molecular size measure different things. Random steps lead to the radius of gyration, Kuhn length, probability distributions and entropic elasticity, followed by semiflexible chains, rings and branches.
- [zh] [链遇到自己和溶剂时：排除体积与溶液行为](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp04/index.md) — 同一种长链放进不同液体，为什么会舒展、收缩，甚至让溶液变浑？从一根绳子的空间占据开始，理解分子之间的接触如何改变线团大小，再把这些变化与混合、渗透压和溶液浓度联系起来。
- [en] [A Chain Meets Itself and Its Solvent: Excluded Volume](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp04/en/index.md) — Why does the same long molecule expand in one liquid, contract in another, or make a solution turn cloudy? Starting with the space occupied by a flexible chain, this chapter connects molecular contacts to coil size, mixing, osmotic pressure and concentration.
- [zh] [许多长链聚在一起：共混、微相结构与结晶](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp05/index.md) — 两种塑料混合后可能形成均匀材料，也可能分成微小区域；把不同链段接在同一分子上，又能得到规则的层和柱。沿着这些现象，从长链的混合自由能走向微相分离与折叠链晶体，理解分子连接、界面和构象如何共同决定材料内部的组织。
- [en] [Many Chains Together: Blending, Microphases and Crystallization](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp05/en/index.md) — Two polymers can form a uniform material or separate into domains. Connecting unlike blocks within each molecule can instead produce organized layers and cylinders. Follow these phenomena from the free energy of mixing to microphase separation and folded-chain crystals, and see how connectivity, interfaces and conformation organize a material.
- [zh] [材料怎样改变状态：相变、临界现象与标度](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp06/index.md) — 冰融化时吸热，某些共混物接近分相温度时变得浑浊，磁体升温后会失去自发磁化。这些变化怎样从许多分子的运动中产生？从相平衡和序参量出发，逐步建立自由能、涨落、关联长度与标度的联系，并用可操作的自由能模型比较连续转变和不连续转变。
- [en] [How Materials Change State: Transitions, Criticality and Scaling](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp06/en/index.md) — Ice absorbs heat as it melts, some blends turn cloudy near demixing, and magnets lose spontaneous magnetization on heating. How do collective changes emerge from molecular motion? Starting with phase equilibrium and order parameters, connect free energy, fluctuations, correlation length and scaling, and compare continuous and discontinuous transitions through an interactive free-energy model.
- [zh] [会排列的长分子：高分子液晶的统计物理](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp07/index.md) — 长分子既能流动，又能沿某个方向保持集体排列，这种组合使材料具有方向相关的光学和力学性质。从浑浊液体为何仍有秩序讲起，用取向概率、排除体积和平均场逐步解释液晶形成，再把分子模型连接到柔性链、局部纹理与加工后的材料性能。
- [en] [Long Molecules That Align: Polymer Liquid Crystals](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp07/en/index.md) — Long molecules can flow while retaining collective alignment, combining mobility with direction-dependent optical and mechanical properties. - [zh] [材料边界为何重要：高分子表面与界面](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp08/index.md) — 水滴是否铺开、胶体是否团聚、涂层是否牢固，都可能由很薄的边界区域决定。跟随一条长链接近墙面、吸附或被一端固定的过程，理解构象、渗透压和界面自由能如何共同作用，再把这些概念用于聚合物刷、共混界面与膜孔中的传输。
- [en] [Why Boundaries Matter: Polymer Surfaces and Interfaces](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp08/en/index.md) — Whether a drop spreads, colloids aggregate or a coating adheres can depend on a very thin boundary region. Connect conformation, osmotic pressure and interfacial free energy, then apply the ideas to polymer brushes, blend interfaces and transport through pores.
- [zh] [从分枝到凝胶：分形、逾渗与网络](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp09/index.md) — 一锅液体为什么会连成能够承力的整体？一团看似稀疏的导电填料怎样贯穿材料？从放大后仍然参差的形状出发，追踪连接形成、网络承力与吸水膨胀的不同机制，理解凝胶形成和凝胶体积转变。

- [zh] [蛋白质螺旋怎样形成：协同折叠的统计图景](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp10/index.md) — 一段蛋白质螺旋的形成，要同时安排原子接触与主链姿势。为什么开始一段比继续延长更有代价，许多微观排列又怎样变成一条实验曲线？从三个位置的手算例子走向有限长链，理解协同性、平均螺旋含量与折叠时间各自回答什么问题。

- [zh] [变化为什么有方向：不可逆过程与耗散](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp11/index.md) — 热茶会冷却，染料会扩散，流动的聚合物会把机械功转为热。能量守恒并没有禁止这些过程倒着发生，那么时间方向从何而来？从粒子计数和随机运动出发，连接熵、扩散、热流与黏性耗散，理解平衡和持续受驱动的材料。
- [en] [Why Processes Have a Direction: Irreversibility and Dissipation](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp11/en/index.md) — Tea cools, dye spreads, and a flowing polymer converts mechanical work into heat. Energy conservation alone does not prohibit the reverse processes, so where does their direction come from? Connect particle counting and random motion to entropy, diffusion, heat flow and viscous dissipation, distinguishing equilibrium from continuously driven materials.
- [zh] [长链怎样移动和回弹：柔性高分子的动力学](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp12/index.md) — 同一块软材料，缓慢拉动时会流动，快速拉动时却明显回弹。沿着加载、等待和释放的过程，理解应力如何消失；再把宏观松弛连接到链段运动、流体耦合和缠结约束，用可调节的振荡实验读懂储能与损耗。
- [en] [How Flexible Chains Move and Relax](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp12/en/index.md) — The same soft material can flow under slow loading and recoil under rapid deformation. - [zh] [简单规律为何产生复杂变化：混沌入门](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/cp15/index.md) — 一个严格确定的更新规则，也可能产生长期不重复、对起始状态极其敏感的变化。从一条可以手算的迭代关系出发，观察稳定值、周期翻倍和混沌怎样接续出现，再把这些概念带回流动材料的结构反馈、测量和预测问题。

- [zh] [同一种反应，为什么要用不同的反应器](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/biomaterials-courses/pe02/index.md) — 一锅做完再出料、边进料边搅拌、沿着长管连续前进，看起来只是容器不同，却会改变分子经历的浓度、反应时间和产物去向。从一份物料收支表出发，逐步理解反应速率、三种理想反应器、选择性与设备组合，学会判断什么时候需要更大的容器，什么时候应该换一种操作方式。

Starting with these objects, explore molecular connections, internal organization, processing history and property measurements to understand how a resin becomes a useful material.
